page.overview:
Who is Ms. Bryant?

Ms. Bryant is the manager of the Freddy Fazbear Pizza Kit Factory from Pizza Kit, the third story in Fazbear Frights 9: The Puppet Carver.

Ms. Bryant is a pretty, short black woman. During the tour, she wears a net cap and a Chica costume.
